items.q: So then, after we worked with Fletcher, now all the time working with Fletcher, Cab, he says

ctx.x: He wanted us to come to the Cotton Club, and we was working in the Green Lantern Room at the Edison Hotel with Stuff. The Cotton Club had moved downtown and he had come backstage there and talked about joining the band. You know, he was trying out trumpet players. That's when I sent Diz down. I said, "Look he's trying out trumpet players down there, Diz, why don't you go down there and see about that?" You know, so he went down and he got the job. So I stayed with Stuff, because I wasn't particular about leaving…
you to come with the band," you know. So I said all right. So I had to put in a notice. So he said okay. So then I tell Fletcher.
